question: Find the display names of users who posted highly viewed content (over 25,000 views) in 2012 and also earned a badge that same year. Additionally, among their posts from 2012, include only those that are linked to at least one other post via postLinks.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN postLinks AS pl ON p."XCL_026" = pl."XCL_023"
WHERE p."XCL_030" > 25000
  AND strftime('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2012'
  AND strftime('%Y', b."XCL_004") = '2012'
